scope: Twelve soc_fan methods pass all eight hard-protocol core gates against the same reproducible R10 module. The stock .altinstructions bytes and relocation targets are also identical. nb_fan_probe, nb_fan_parse_dt, and fan_speed_show remain unreconstructed. The driver-wide audit/runtime evidence remains incomplete_or_failed; promotion is not authorized.

Two clean Docker builds are reproducible. The stock and candidate ELF symbols both measure 60 bytes; the LSE/LL-SC alternative table is byte- and relocation-identical. Driver-wide audit/runtime evidence remains incomplete_or_failed; promotion is not authorized.
